predecessors.name: Empire of Brazil
predecessors.text: the city of Belém, 'conquered' on the night of 6 January 1835

successors.name: Empire of Brazil
successors.text: the interior of the province of Grão-Pará, where 'the last rebel group, under the leadership of Gonçalo Jorge de Magalhães, yielded' in 1840; the page names no place, so the province minus the Belém…

wars.name: Cabanagem
wars.outcome: Imperial victory: Belém lost by the rebels between the July events and 14 August 1835 (no day on the page), retaken on 14 August 1835, abandoned in April 1836 under naval blockade; resistance from the interior to the 1839 amnesty and the 1840 surrender; 'more…

certainty.note: The rebels held a city and then an unnamed interior; no boundary is described on the page.
